summary: El Paso County mountain where September 1911 newspapers reported a planned fire lookout station; no source confirms it was built or what remains.

facts.status_note: No source confirms a lookout was built on the mountain.

events.note: The Colorado Springs Gazette and a Routt County paper, September 1911, report a planned fire lookout for that fall. Construction is not confirmed.

evidence.supports: Gazette, September 1911: fire lookout station to be maintained on Cheyenne Mountain that fall
evidence.quote: A fire lookout station will be maintained on Cheyenne mountain by the government forestry department this fall

evidence.supports: Gazette: the station will overlook the eastern slope of the Front Range
evidence.quote: It will overlook the eastern slope of the Front range.

evidence.supports: Gazette: one of three lookouts to be placed in the Rocky Mountains that fall
evidence.quote: will be one of three to be placed in the Rocky mountains this fall by the government.

evidence.supports: Gazette: number of men to be employed not officially announced
evidence.quote: The number of men to be employed, while not officially announced, will be sufficient to forestall possibilities of forest fires

evidence.supports: Routt County paper, 22 September 1911: station overlooking the eastern slope near Colorado Springs
evidence.quote: overlooking the eastern slope of the Front range, near Colorado Springs, this fall.

corrections.why: Spelling error in the brief. The Wikipedia article's citation is titled 'Pike National Forest, Pikes Peak Ranger District'.

notes_for_editor: Only 1911 newspaper quotes, a coordinates index and Wikipedia describe this site. Brief kind and status stay unknown. The source page itself misspells the forest as 'Pike Natioinal Forest'; the correction uses the spelling from the Wikipedia citation. Search returned Devil's Head Lookout (Pike NF, Douglas County) and other towers; these are different sites, so they were not used. Search snippets gave a 1912 build date and a 1919 first tower for Devil's Head, not this mountain; not used. Wikipedia's 1911 Overlook Colony is a residential colony, not a lookout; not used. Two searches and four page reads used.
